description: This file contains Bash shell script code for testing Git's handling of packed refs, including setup procedures, test cases for packed refs behavior, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, runs a sequence of commands, verifies results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual outputs for test validation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository, optionally with no tags.
